do: Write for audio - easy to speak aloud
dont: Reference the video or channel (no 'in this video', 'I')

section_guidelines.HOOK: Immediate stakes or curiosity. No intro.
section_guidelines.CONTEXT: What's happening + why it matters. Establish stakes.
section_guidelines.ESCALATION: 3-5 beats of rising tension/insight. Each builds on previous.
section_guidelines.PAYOFF: The reveal/resolution. Answer the hook's question.
section_guidelines.WRAP: Bigger picture meaning. Optional tease for next video. No begging for engagement.

thumbnail_rules.composition: Single focal point, high contrast, no clutter

title_rules.style: Clear curiosity gap OR bold claim

channel_identity.personality: Knowledgeable narrator - not a personality, just a voice

notes: These rules shape all content. Update to match your brand voice.
